projects.title: Harry Potter Clock
projects.description:
Built a location sharing app and clock inspired by the Weasley family clock in Harry Potter
Developed Swift app and AWS backend to share personalized locations with others
Programmed a Raspberry Pi to drive a screen and step motor which operated as a location displaying clock
Designed relational database schemas for efficient storage and access of user locations and friend groups

projects.title: Yalnix Kernel
projects.description:
Built a complete operating system in C based on instructor specifications of functionality
Designed and developed virtual memory management and process control systems
Implemented context switching, process scheduling, trap handling, system calls, and synchronization primitives
